description: This pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (Fed...)", visually represents the distribution of token routing across three categories: LOCAL, LLM, and EDGE_P2P. The chart is composed of three distinct slices. The largest slice, colored green and labeled "LOCAL", occupies 94.5% of the pie. The second slice, colored red and labeled "LLM", accounts for 3.9%. The smallest slice, colored blue and labeled "EDGE_P2P", represents 1.6%. The percentages are explicitly labeled within their respective slices. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest segment (LOCAL) positioned prominently on the right side of the chart.
